search.description: Verbatim text copied EXACTLY from the Current File Contents (whitespace and indentation included, 3-5+ lines so the match is unique). Never regex, anchors (^ $), ellipsis, line numbers, or paraphrase. To insert at the top of a file, use its first 3-5 actual lines here and put the new lines before them in 'replace'.

replace.description: Replacement text that takes the place of 'search' verbatim.

uncertainties.description: Risks, open questions, or assumptions made under time pressure.
